changelog:
Initial release of the Flux Kanban Agent skill.

- Manage Flux kanban boards, cards, columns, and labels via the Flux REST API.
- Supports creating, moving, and updating cards; assigning members; toggling labels; and building board automations.
- Includes workspace, board, column, card, checklist, comment, label, attachment, search, and undo endpoints.
- Authentication via API key (`FLUX_API_KEY`) with optional custom base URL.
- Provides detailed setup instructions, workflows, and important usage notes.
